summary.name: MWeb
summary.one_liner: MWeb is a Markdown writing, note-taking, and publishing app for macOS, iPadOS, and iOS, with a static blog generator in its macOS Pro version.
use_cases: taking and organizing notes with categories and tags
generating a static blog from a category of notes
publishing documents to WordPress, Medium, Ghost or other platforms
exporting notes to PDF or Epub e-books
syncing notes across Apple devices with iCloud
summary.what_it_does: MWeb is a Markdown editor built on CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown, supporting tables, code blocks, math formulas, task lists, and footnotes, with inline image display and Mermaid and ECharts previews. Its Folders mode manages Markdown and Textbundle files in folders with full-text search and image handling. Its Library mode stores notes in category trees and tags, syncs via iCloud CloudKit, and keeps data in a local folder for backup. The page also lists publishing to services such as WordPress, Blogger, and Medium, image uploads to hosts like imgur and Amazon S3, and export to PDF, Epub, or image.
notable: Library mode with category trees, tags, and iCloud CloudKit sync, stored as a local folder
Static blog generation from note categories in the macOS Pro version
Native builds using AppKit on macOS and UIKit on iOS/iPadOS
11 light and 21 dark editor themes plus custom themes and CSS preview styles
caveats: Static blog generation is listed only for the macOS version of MWeb Pro
Some features, such as Dropbox folder support, are listed only for iPadOS/iOS
Page mentions an IAP discount for a limited window (5/29 to 6/4), so it may be outdated
